leads.name: Kopfulme in der Beerlage
leads.note: A pollarded white elm, completely hollow with an opening you can stand in, 5.34 m round at 1.30 m and 12.4 m tall, planted around 1650 (plus or minus 70 years), Naturdenkmal since 2014, publicly accessible. Baumkunde register 3375. Named on 2026-10-02 by Wolfgang Schurmann, moderator of that register, as his favourite tree, in reply to Hidde's mail; he visits it often. Beerlage is a Bauerschaft of Billerbeck, Kreis Coesfeld, about 5 km from Billerbeck station (RB63 from Munster, 30 min), so not inside Munster's day-trip boundary. Billerbeck has no page; the four-tree floor is paused for new places (2026-10-01), so this waits for three more Billerbeck or Coesfeld trees, or for the pause to lift.
